title: How Are You?
label: ch:fa-how-are-you
canDo: I can ask how someone is in careful respectful Persian and answer that I am well, thank you.

payoff.summary: The careful wellbeing exchange in two moves: hâl-e shomâ chetor ast? answered khubam, mamnun; then hâl, chetor and khub taken apart by meaning and history, and حال, چطور, خوب and خوبم read off the page.
payoff.note: FA-C04-practice is the chapter's last lesson and assesses all sixteen atoms the chapter introduces: the exchange itself, a spoken recall of hâl, chetor and khub with their Arabic and inherited Persian layers, and a script section reading the four written words.
